content: Amettiř n řemřac
Ma war tessinem ca, a aytma, ssawařeɣ ak-d yinni issnen Ccariɛa, aqa Ccariɛa tṣeǧeḍ x bnadem min ɣa yekk iddar?
Tamɣart teqqen ɣar weryaz nnes s Ccariɛa min ɣa yekk iddar, maca mařa immut weryaz nnes, aqa tᵉttwafekk zi Ccariɛa zi jjihet n weryaz nnes.

Maca mařa ad teqqen ɣar weryaz nneɣni min ɣa yekk weryaz iddar, tᵉttwaḥseb zzayes aqa nettat tezna. Maca mařa immut weryaz nnes, ad taf ad tᵉttwafekk zi Ccariɛa, aqa war tezni mařa temřec ak-d weryaz nneɣni.
Xenni, a aytma, kenniw ɛawed aqa temmutem i Ccariɛa s Arrimet n Lmasiḥ, ḥima ad tdewřem i Wenneɣni i wenni dd-ikkaren zi taddart n imettinen, ḥima ad tewcem řɣiǧet i AREBBI.
Minzi umi d aneɣ tuɣa deg weysum, tuɣa ccehwat n ddnub xeddment deg iɣezdisen n arrimet nneɣ am ttwaɛarnent zi Ccariɛa ařami ɣa awyent řɣiǧet i řmewt.
Maca řexxu aqa nettwafekk zi Ccariɛa, aqa nemmut x min di tuɣa nettwaḥbes, ḥima ad neɛbed AREBBI s tejdidet n Arruḥ, war iǧi di ṣṣifet taqdimt n Tira Iqeddsen.
Amenɣi ak-d ddnub
Min ɣa nini xenni? Ma Ccariɛa d ddenb? Ɛemmarṣ! Maca war ssineɣ ddenb mɣir s Ccariɛa waha, maɣar war ssineɣ nnecwet mařa war tenni Ccariɛa: “War ttasem!”
Maca ddenb yufa lfurṣa s tewṣeyyet uca tegma dayi kuř nnecwet, minzi břa Ccariɛa ddenb immut.
Zic tuɣa ddareɣ břa Ccariɛa, maca umi dd-tusa tewṣeyyet, ibda ddenb ad iddar, uca mmuteɣ.
Ufiɣ belli tawṣeyyet i iǧan i tudart tneddeh ɣar řmewt.
Minzi ddenb am yufa lfurṣa s tewṣeyyet, icmet ayi uca inɣa ayi zzayes.
Xenni Ccariɛa iqeddsen i teǧa u tawṣeyyet iqeddsen i teǧa, tsegged u teṣbeḥ.
Ma idweř ayi min iǧan d aṣebḥan d řmewt inu? Ɛemmarṣ! Maca ddenb, ḥima ad iban d ddenb, issegma dayi řmewt s min iǧan d aṣebḥan, ḥima ad idweř ddenb d ddenb ktar s tewṣiyyet.
Aqa nessen belli Ccariɛa n Arruḥ i teǧa, maca necc d aysum, mmenzeɣ i ddenb,
minzi war ssineɣ min ɣa ggeɣ, uca min xseɣ, war t tteggeɣ, maca min carrheɣ d manawenni i tteggeɣ.
Mařa tteggeɣ min war ttexseɣ, ad wafqeɣ ak-d Ccariɛa, belli aqa nettat teṣbeḥ.
Maca řexxu necc war tteggeɣ man aya ɛad, maca ddenb i d ayi izeddɣen ittegg i-t.
Minzi ssneɣ war dayi izeddeɣ min icnan, ixs ad yini deg weysum inu. Minzi ihwen xafi maḥend ad xseɣ tcuni, maca war zemmareɣ ad tt ggeɣ.
Minzi war tteggeɣ tcuni i xseɣ, maca řɣar i war ttexseɣ ca, d manawenni i tteggeɣ.
Mařa tteggeɣ min war ttexseɣ, war iǧi ɛad d necc i itteggen man aya, maca ddenb wenni d ayi izeddɣen.
Xenni ttafeɣ ict n ccariɛa tenni tusa-dd ak-d tnefsect inu, tenni ixsen ad igg tcuni, am yudes ayi-dd řɣar.
Minzi farḥeɣ s Ccariɛa n AREBBI zi jjihet n bnadem nni iǧan di daxeř inu,
maca ttwařiɣ din ccariɛa nneɣni deg iɣezdisen n arrimet inu, tᵉttmenɣa ak-d ccariɛa n řeɛqeř inu uca tḥebbes ayi s ccariɛa n ddenb tenni iǧan deg iɣezdisen n arrimet inu.
Ayeḥḥat mana wemcum-a n bnadem i ǧiɣ! Wi d ayi ɣa issnejmen zi arrimet-a n řmewt?
Ttqadiɣ AREBBI, wenni i d ayi issenjmen s ufus n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ!
Ammu aqa necc simant inu s řeɛqeř i xeddmeɣ i Ccariɛa n AREBBI, maca deg weysum inu i ccariɛa n ddenb.

footnotes.text: 'war iǧi di ṣṣifet taqdimt n Tira Iqeddsen' - Tira Iqeddsen ssawařent x Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ. Netta d Atarras Amezwaru n Wedlis Iqeddsen zeg wedlis Umezwaru ař adlis n Usargeb ɣar uneggar nnes. Wenni iqqaren Adlis Iqeddsen (ixs ad yina Tira Iqeddsen) neḥřa ma issen Utarras Amezwaru n Wedlis, iǧa di teqdimt n Tira Iqeddsen, ixs ad yini, netta iqqar břa ma ittwaři Atarras nni Amezwaru, netta am ijj n bnadem d adarɣař. Adlis i iqqar, war iddar i netta, maca i netta d adlis nni am ijj n umetta. S uyenni wenni iqqaren ammu, aqa netta di teqdimt n Tira Iqeddsen, war iǧi di tmaynut n Arruḥ. Maɣar mɣir mařa ijj n bnadem issen Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ s wuř u s liman, ad iqbeř Arruḥ Iqeddsen uřa d tamaynut n Arruḥ di daxeř nnes uca ad iɣar Adlis Iqeddsen s yijj n ccekl d jdid, minzi Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ Netta d Atarras Amezwaru n Wedlis Iqeddsen.
